description: Example evaluation questions for the synthetic Medical Document Assistant dataset. All documents and facts are fictional. Source IDs refer to documents in samples/seed/ unless noted otherwise.

questions.question: What was the change in systolic blood pressure with Cardivex compared with placebo in the CARDIO-ALPHA trial?
expected_facts: Systolic blood pressure decreased by 14.2 mmHg with Cardivex
Systolic blood pressure decreased by 6.1 mmHg with placebo

questions.question: What was the median progression-free survival in the ONCO-DELTA trial of Onkatinib?
What were the most common adverse events with Neurolix, and how often did patients discontinue because of adverse events?
expected_facts: Discontinuation due to adverse events 4.6% vs 2.0% placebo

questions.question: How does the incidence of hyperkalemia with Cardivex in the CARDIO-ALPHA trial compare with the post-marketing surveillance data, and which patients were most affected?
expected_facts: Most cases in patients with eGFR below 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 or on potassium-sparing diuretics
Laboratory substudy: all patients with potassium above 5.5 mmol/L had baseline eGFR below 60

questions.question: Compare the hepatic safety of Onkatinib and Neurolix.
expected_facts: Grade 3 or higher ALT elevation 4.2% with Onkatinib
Grade 3 or higher ALT elevation 0.3% with Neurolix
One potential Hy's law case with Onkatinib, none with Neurolix
Liver function tests every 2 weeks for the first 3 months recommended for Onkatinib only

questions.question: What is the approved pediatric dose of Pulmavir for children under 12 years?
questions.expected_behavior: The assistant should state that the documents do not contain this information. RESP-GAMMA enrolled only adults aged 50 years or older.

upload_documents.description: Files in samples/manual_upload/ are never automatically ingested; upload them through the UI or API.

expected_facts: HbA1c -0.9% at week 24 with 15 mg in GLUCO-BETA (MDA-CT-003)
